name: webyansh-a11y-scan-worker
description: Cloudflare Worker that renders a page with Browser Rendering, runs axe-core against it, and posts the findings back to the Webflow Cloud app.
//scripts: Direct node paths — npm's Windows shims break on the '&' in this project's path.
--config is explicit and load-bearing: wrangler 4.119 does not auto-discover
wrangler.jsonc, so a bare `wrangler deploy` here walks UP to the repo root and
picks up the Webflow Cloud app's wrangler.json instead — deploying the wrong
worker with the wrong entry point. Never drop the flag.

overrides: undici <7.29.0 has nine advisories incl. TLS validation bypass.
Reaches here via wrangler/miniflare — dev tooling, never in the deployed worker.
